name: Pet Central
description: Warm, funny, and genuinely useful television for animal people: rescue stories from The Dodo and Kitten Lady, grooming and big personalities with Girl With The Dogs, cat behavior with Jackson Galaxy, positive-reinforcement dog training from Zak George and Kikopup, Simon's Cat cartoons in the morning, and Animalogic's deep dives into why animals do what they do -- an eight-show, 24-hour daily lineup built around themed dayparts from Morning Cuteness to Evening Pet Stories.
